cv.header.description.message: Curriculum vitae of Antonio Ionta, Software Engineer and Tech Leader.

cv.sections.profile.paragraph.1.message: Expert in coordinating projects involving the entire software development life cycle, both from a technical and managerial perspective. Developer of Web back-end applications with Java EE and the aid of Spring and Quarkus frameworks and JPA technology. Focus on in-cloud microservice environments. Developer of middleware back-end applications with Apache WSO2, Scala, and Spark, within Data Engineering contexts. Strong supporter of Test Driven Development (TDD). Experienced in agile development principles and adherence to the SCRUM methodology. Enthusiastic about front-end development, explored in small academic projects. Passionate Community Manager.

cv.experience.adesso.paragraph.1.message: Within the development team of a microservices ecosystem for client GNV (Grandi Navi Veloci S.p.A.): porting of the legacy maritime transport booking system for passengers and cargo, with a focus on back-office processes and integration with port operators' systems.

cv.experience.adesso.responsibility.1.message: Design and development of back-end services in Java (Spring), with adoption of advanced architectural patterns for managing distributed complexity (Saga for transaction management).

cv.experience.adesso.responsibility.2.message: Data persistence management on relational databases using JPA.

cv.experience.adesso.responsibility.3.message: Implementation of asynchronous communication via Kafka and caching strategies using Redis and Elasticsearch for performance optimization.

cv.experience.adesso.responsibility.4.message: Participation in a LeSS (Large-Scale Scrum) organizational context, with active contribution to backlog definition through reverse engineering activities on the legacy system. Atlassian suite (Bitbucket, Jira, Confluence).

cv.experience.adesso.responsibility.5.message: Use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot) to support both functional definition and implementation.

cv.experience.bemind.paragraph.1.message: Development and deployment of full-stack Web applications with TypeScript and Node.js integrating AI tools. Setup of agile workflow and issue tracking.

cv.experience.bemind.responsibility.1.message: Independent development and deployment of a Fastify application for data scraping activities, using OCR processing (Llama Parse) and data persistence through ORM (Prisma).

cv.experience.bemind.responsibility.2.message: Participation in the AI-driven development of software components for "Optims", a SaaS platform for managing construction sites, employees, equipment, training, and compliance in the construction sector; working in a team on a Next.js (front-end), NestJS, and Prisma (back-end) stack, with deployment on Railway and an agentic workflow based on Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, integrated via MCP with Chrome DevTools and ClickUp.

cv.experience.aizoon.role.message: Back-end Software Engineer and Tech Leader

cv.experience.aizoon.paragraph.1.message: Design, development, and maintenance of “aramis”, a network monitoring platform for cybersecurity risk detection using Machine Learning. Monolithic architecture partitioned into functional components cooperating through a plugin-pattern and supported by a data streaming platform (Apache Kafka). Back-end in Java/Spring, TDD approach, quality assurance with SonarQube. One of the technical leaders of the working group.

cv.experience.aizoon.paragraph.2.message: Head of a project for the development of a microservices-based Web portal for Public Administration, deployed on Azure cloud. Hybrid back-end Java/Spring, Python/FastAPI. Authentication via multiple providers, including SPID, CIE, CNS; custom authorization with Spring Security. Technical and managerial leadership.

cv.experience.aizoon.paragraph.3.message: Issue tracking aligned with the agile Scrum methodology using YouTrack and Azure DevOps.

cv.experience.aizoon.responsibility.1.message: Architecture and model design of importable Java functional components through Maven.

cv.experience.aizoon.responsibility.2.message: Development of Java APIs for interaction with MongoDB using low-level driver functionalities for custom (de)serialization of data.

cv.experience.aizoon.responsibility.3.message: Integration of the Java library Tribuo into application logic to efficiently perform specific Machine Learning operations (clustering).

cv.experience.aizoon.responsibility.4.message: Creation of a protected-access documentation system based on Git-flow-like principles, Docusaurus stack, and GitLab Pages.

cv.experience.aizoon.responsibility.5.message: Deployment of Java applications on remote Linux servers (via SSH) using SystemD configurations. Monitoring via the Telegraf, InfluxDB, Grafana stack and JVM-related tools.

cv.experience.aizoon.responsibility.6.message: Database change management with rollback support, applying DevOps principles using Liquibase and Flyway.

cv.experience.aizoon.responsibility.7.message: Use of main Azure in-cloud services, e.g., AD B2C, AKS, key vault, data storage.

cv.experience.exaltechConsulting.client.message: Full-remote consulting for client e-distribuzione S.p.A. (Enel Group).

cv.experience.exaltechConsulting.paragra.message: Development of back-end Web applications with Java EE, Spring framework, and JPA technology, following the microservices model, and development of back-end middleware applications with Apache WSO2, Scala + Spark, as part of a large-scale digitalization (“Platformization”) project of the e-distribuzione power grid information system across several regions worldwide.
Activities carried out in adherence to the agile Scrum software engineering methodology, using Jira.

cv.experience.exaltechConsulting.respons.message: Server-side design and development of a microservice for retrieving disaggregated data from remote sources (e.g., CSV files on SharePoint), mapping and exposing data in different formats with filtering capabilities, and persisting extracted data in a relational database with scheduled batch insertions. Server-side design and development of a business-service proxy for orchestration in the deployment environment.
Analysis, design, and server-side development of various batch business-services for integrating large volumes of data from multiple disaggregated remote sources.
Monitoring, maintenance, and debugging of server-side services in the deployment environment.

cv.experience.exaltech.paragraph.1.message: Initial internship aimed at employment. Development of Web back-end applications with Java EE using Spring and Quarkus frameworks and JPA technology, following the microservices model. Introduction to front-end software development using Angular JS and Webpack.

cv.experience.exaltech.responsibility.1.message: Server-side design and development of a demonstrative system for managing material handling for a hypothetical transport company: management of clients, suppliers, routes, costs, invoicing.

cv.experience.exaltech.responsibility.2.message: Server-side design and development of a file management and storage system across multiple platforms with image editing features for internal company use.

cv.experience.exaltech.responsibility.3.message: Server-side design and development of an internal system for managing worker occupancy estimates, interfacing with the corporate timesheet.

cv.experience.exaltech.responsibility.4.message: Server-side design and development of an electronic invoicing management system for consumption by banks and related clients. Microservices architecture design, Oracle database management, and implementation in Spring Boot 2 and Java 8: XML invoice archiving and validation, submission to Public Administration, management of invoice outcomes from the Interchange System; data caching for users and companies using Redis. BPM and Message Broker systems were also integrated.

cv.experience.exaltech.responsibility.5.message: Server-side development of a demonstrative Web application automating the matching between electronic invoice line items and purchase orders.

cv.education.master.degree.message: Master’s Degree in “Engineering in Computer Science” with final grade 110/110 cum laude

cv.education.master.institution.message: University of Rome "La Sapienza" – Faculty of "Information Engineering, Computer Science and Statistics".

cv.education.master.thesis.message: “Telemetry Monitoring in Industry 4.0: A Comparative Analysis of NoSQL-based Solutions with Focus on MongoDB and InfluxDB”

cv.education.master.paragraph.1.message: Re-engineering of a software component of a platform used for mobile, real-time visualization of temporal trends of physical quantities from machines or sensors within an industrial plant ("time series in IIoT"). The redesign focused particularly on the data layer, studying non-relational persistence approaches through a comparative workflow featuring MongoDB and InfluxDB as main actors. The work included an implementation part resulting in a Java application capable of performing MongoDB-InfluxDB data porting, mapping the different data models, and benchmarking query performance (using the JMH library).

cv.education.bachelor.degree.message: Bachelor’s Degree in “Ingegneria dell'Informazione” with final grade 110/110 cum laude

cv.education.bachelor.institution.message: University of Rome "La Sapienza" – Faculty of "Information Engineering, Computer Science and Statistics".

cv.education.bachelor.thesis.message: update, development, and testing of a Web application based on the Moodle platform for managing e-learning activities with a focus on peer-assessment.

cv.languages.english.paragraph.2.message: Reading, listening, spoken production, spoken interaction and writing: B2.

cv.languages.english.note.1.message: Master’s degree obtained following a course delivered entirely in English.
